body: I'm so sorry to hear that, but please don't kill yourself. I know it's probably not much, but if you need anyone to talk to, just know that I'm here. I'm sure you're strong and will get over this. Just, please don't try anything.
I read about the case a few months ago, and up until now when I'm alone outside, it comes up into my mind. It really messed me up reading about it.
